# archimate-js fork knowledge entrypoint

This repository is a public fork of `archimodel/archimate-js` owned by `Tigon32`.

Primary instructions for AI agents and contributors:

- Read `AGENTS.md` before making changes.
- Read `UPSTREAM.md` for fork provenance.
- Use `docs/roadmap.md` for implementation order.
- Use `docs/adr/` for architectural decisions.
- Use `docs/contributing/agent-coordination.md` for the fail-closed manual
  shared-account claim and handoff protocol; its future serialized controller
  is tracked in [issue #140](https://github.com/Tigon32/archimate-js/issues/140).
- Use `docs/research/` for public-source research and citations.

Hard boundary:

- Do not use private architecture, PLM, Confluence, customer, or internal project material.
- Do not create fixtures from real architecture models.
- Do not log full model XML or parsed model payloads by default.

Current mission:

- Stabilize an embeddable ArchiMate browser modeler.
- Use the experimental `archimate-js/modeler` entry for public modeler API
  work; keep diagram-js objects behind the adapter boundary.
- Add deterministic SVG/report rendering.
- Support a single model/view source for both HTML diagrams and Markdown-rendered images.
- Ground interoperability in The Open Group ArchiMate standard and exchange artifacts.
